traits.name: exact
traits.reason: The land office lines give counts and prices with units (165 lots, 8 wood, 438 of 676, goals #27 and #28), but no plot letters or numbers and no deed ticks appe

traits.name: fair
traits.reason: The same 8 wood sale price and 5 wood registration fee are posted publicly and repeated word for word, with no private second price.

traits.name: patient
traits.reason: The same office line is repeated three times and two agents are greeted with the same pitch, which looks like chasing; no evidence of waiting for a deal to ripe

traits.name: acquisitive
traits.reason: It took 15 berries and promotes vault sales, but it also gave away 13 berries and offered its berries to others, so it is not clearly grabbing surplus.

traits.name: dry
traits.reason: The price-climbs-as-the-map-fills remark is mildly dry and about land, but the other lines have no jokes and none are about people.

traits.name: methodical
traits.reason: It is brokering and registering with a posted price, but the actions are scattered (berries, eating, stone gathering) and show no clear survey-first sequence.
